'''Virtual Set 1: Legacy''' is the first of the [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|numbered Virtual Sets]] the [[Players Committee]] released between 2002 and 2009. Each of its 12 cards is a printed slip that replaces the bottom half of a [[Decipher]] card (new game text, stats and icons) while the card's title, lore and art stay as printed. The set became tournament-legal on 9 March 2002.<ref name="legal" /> In December 2006 the Committee reissued it as a ''Remaster'' sheet with new pack art, a set symbol and the final text; that sheet is the source for the slips shown here.<ref name="ia" /> Icons used on the slips are explained at [[Virtual card icons]].

The second image in each row is a full-card remaster: the printed Decipher card with the slip re-typeset at 600 DPI in the style of the Committee's later Holotable cards, made for the wiki in 2026 (see [[Typography of Star Wars CCG cards]]). These are fan reconstructions, not Committee products. Game text is written out the way the sheet's icon key defines its shorthand.

== History ==
=== Launch vs later update ===

Virtual Set #1 launched as a publicly referenced Players Committee virtual product (Decipher cardlists: tournament-legal 03-09-02). Early printable packaging includes VirtualCards1a and the Premium Edition slip sheet.

A later PC sheet archived as VirtualCards1.pdf is titled Virtual Set 1: Legacy and states Official text as of December 4, 2006 (footer: SWCCG Player's Committee 2006). That sheet is the source used here for the set symbol and pack example art. It is not the Premium remaster alone, and it is not the earliest 2002 1a sheet; it documents a later text refresh of the same twelve titles.

=== Provenance ===

Decipher's own cardlists index (Internet Archive snapshot 11 June 2002) lists Players Committee virtual sets alongside official products:

<blockquote>In addition, virtual card sets from the SWCCG Player's Committee provide new game text for selected cards. In printable PDF format, text may be sleeved with your original cards for tournament-legal play. Choose limited-edition (BB) or unlimited-edition (WB) printouts, optionally with DS text in white on black ("A" numbers).</blockquote>

And under SWCCG PLAYER'S COMMITTEE VIRTUAL CARD SETS:

<blockquote>Virtual Card Set #1 &ndash; 12 cards. Tournament-legal 03-09-02.</blockquote>

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020611031545/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html] (IA 20020611031545).
